name: web-b

info.notes:
web-b serves on port 80 in tern-test-helm.
Mode: default
API token: tok-REDACTME

manifest:
---
# Source: web/templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: web-b-web-auth
type: Opaque
stringData:
  password: "hunter2-REDACTME"
  apiToken: "tok-REDACTME"
---
# Source: web/templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: web-b-web-config
  namespace: tern-test-helm
data:
  mode: "default"
  dsn: "postgres://app:hunter2-REDACTME@db:5432/app"
---
# Source: web/templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web-b-web
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: web
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: web-b
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: web
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: web-b
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
---
# Source: web/templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web-b-web
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: web
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: web-b
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: web
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: web-b
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: web
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: web-b
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: shop
          image: "nginx:1.27-alpine"
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80

hooks.name: web-b-web-pre-upgrade
hooks.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: web-b-web-pre-upgrade
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": pre-upgrade,pre-rollback
    "helm.sh/hook-weight": "-5"
    "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": before-hook-creation
data:
  revision: "1"

hooks.name: web-b-web-post-install
hooks.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: web-b-web-post-install
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": post-install
data:
  installed: "true"
